nodes.label: Bit-Perfect Integer Signal Path vs Float32 Truncation
nodes.norm_label: bit-perfect integer signal path vs float32 truncation
nodes.rationale: IEEE 754 32-bit float only has 24-bit mantissa (25-bit signed precision), truncating 7-8 LSBs of 32-bit integer PCM tracks unless direct integer pass or 64-bit double DSP with TPDF dithering is used.

nodes.label: CoreAudio kAudioDevicePropertyHogMode Exclusive Lock
nodes.rationale: Built-in Apple Silicon ports bypass kAudioDevicePropertyHogMode and run in shared mode, so telemetry must distinguish actual hardware hog lock from user preference.

nodes.label: Hardware Nominal Sample Rate Validation & Fallback
nodes.norm_label: hardware nominal sample rate validation & fallback
nodes.rationale: Checking kAudioDevicePropertyAvailableNominalSampleRates and selecting the nearest integer-multiple rate prevents silent OS software sample rate conversion (SRC) when playing high-rate tracks on limited DACs.

nodes.label: Dual-Channel SplitMix64 TPDF Dithering & std::llrint Rounding
nodes.norm_label: dual-channel splitmix64 tpdf dithering & std::llrint rounding
nodes.rationale: Prevents nonlinear quantization distortion and noise modulation during attenuated (< 0 dBFS) 64-bit double DSP volume scaling by injecting decorrelated triangular PDF noise at target LSB scale before unbiased rounding.

nodes.label: Per-Sample Linear Volume Ramping (Anti-Zipper Noise)
nodes.rationale: Frame-locked linear gain interpolation (currentGain += stepGain) prevents step discontinuities at callback boundaries that otherwise cause audible clicks on low-frequency signals.

nodes.label: Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) Frame Advancement & Thread Safety
nodes.norm_label: atomic compare-and-swap (cas) frame advancement & thread safety
nodes.rationale: Using compare_exchange_strong in handleRender prevents the real-time audio callback from overwriting concurrent user seekTo mutations on m_currentFrame.

nodes.label: 64 MB Sliding-Window Ring Buffer & Background Decode Thread
nodes.norm_label: 64 mb sliding-window ring buffer & background decode thread
nodes.rationale: Pre-decoding 5 seconds synchronously for <50ms startup while streaming the rest on a background thread bounds memory at 64MB, avoiding multi-GB RAM spikes on long 192kHz files.

nodes.label: Real-Time Sample-Accurate Gapless Playback Handover
nodes.rationale: Pre-buffering 32MB of the next track allows CoreAudio handleRender to splice remaining frames seamlessly inside the real-time callback without tearing down the AudioUnit or relying on a 250ms Main Thread timer.

nodes.label: Live Hardware Telemetry JSON & Ring Buffer Event Logger
nodes.norm_label: live hardware telemetry json & ring buffer event logger
nodes.rationale: Replaces hardcoded placebo telemetry strings and live Date() re-evaluation during view body renders with real C++ hardware telemetry JSON parsing and timestamped event logs.

nodes.label: Secure macOS Auto-Updater & Pre-Release SemVer Comparison
nodes.norm_label: secure macos auto-updater & pre-release semver comparison
nodes.rationale: Avoids world-writable /tmp race conditions by using per-UUID cache directories, enforces macOS asset filtering and CFBundleIdentifier/codesign verification, and properly compares pre-release suffixes (alpha < beta < rc < stable).

nodes.norm_label: matriks paritas fitur android vs macos
nodes.rationale: Tracks 33 specific engineering capabilities across Audio Engine, Streaming, Library & Data, Playlist & Queue, Lyrics & Theme, OS Integration, Diagnostics, and Build/Testing.

nodes.rationale: Executive summary and feature parity matrix comparing the Android ground-truth repository (tsrossa-ujicoba) with the macOS port (tsrossa-macos), identifying ~60% parity deficit and ranking 17 findings by severity.

nodes.label: 01 Audit Audio Engine, DSP, & CoreAudio HAL
nodes.norm_label: 01 audit audio engine, dsp, & coreaudio hal
nodes.rationale: Audits C++ signal path, float32 truncation vs int32 bit-perfect pass, 64-bit double DSP attenuation, SplitMix64 TPDF dithering, per-sample volume ramping, sample rate negotiation, and Hog Mode.

nodes.label: 02 Audit Memori, Streaming, Gapless Playback, & Konkurensi
nodes.norm_label: 02 audit memori, streaming, gapless playback, & konkurensi
nodes.rationale: Audits full-file RAM allocation vs 64MB sliding-window ring buffer, mlock/munlock lifecycle, gapless playback handover, and thread safety / atomic CAS synchronization.

nodes.label: 03 Audit Metadata, Database Library, Sorting, & Search
nodes.norm_label: 03 audit metadata, database library, sorting, & search
nodes.rationale: Audits binary FLAC/WAV tag parsing vs AVURLAsset, persistent SQLite library caching, sorting logic bugs, UserDefaults persistence, fuzzy search, and 12-bin hue-family color clustering.

nodes.norm_label: 04 audit ui/ux, telemetri palsu, & integrasi macos
nodes.rationale: Audits hardcoded placebo strings in TelemetryModalView, unwired preferences, global arrow-key hijacking, missing MPNowPlayingInfoCenter media keys, and 3-state RepeatMode vs shuffle deck.

nodes.label: 05 Audit Build System, Keamanan Updater, & Testing
nodes.norm_label: 05 audit build system, keamanan updater, & testing
nodes.rationale: Audits broken standalone build_mac.sh due to missing dr_flac.h/dr_wav.h, hardcoded /Users/alen paths, insecure /tmp updater script and pre-release SemVer bug in UpdateManager.swift, and 0% unit test coverage.

nodes.label: 06 Audit UI/UX Themes, Swift/SwiftUI, Apple HIG, & Liquid Glass
nodes.norm_label: 06 audit ui/ux themes, swift/swiftui, apple hig, & liquid glass
nodes.rationale: Audits platform identity crisis (Material 3 vs Apple Liquid Glass), fake flat GlassmorphicSurface, rigid VStack layout preventing scroll-under refraction, 3579-line God View anti-pattern, and deprecated SwiftUI APIs.

nodes.label: Laporan Audit & Analisa Reverse Engineering Lengkap (Master Report)
nodes.norm_label: laporan audit & analisa reverse engineering lengkap (master report)
nodes.rationale: Master audit report consolidating all 6 parity audit aspects and providing a 4-stage remediation roadmap.

nodes.label: 12-Bin Hue-Family Chromatic Clustering & WCAG Contrast
nodes.rationale: Clustering pixels into 12 30-degree hue bins and filtering shadows/highlights extracts vibrant focal accent colors instead of muddy brown averages produced by naive 40x40 RGB mean.

nodes.label: 07 Audit Bug Window Resize, Double-Tap Fit-to-Screen, & Menu Lag
nodes.norm_label: 07 audit bug window resize, double-tap fit-to-screen, & menu lag
nodes.rationale: Root-cause analysis of the 3 bugs in bug-note.md: ZStack + scaledToFill layout inflation during window resize, HiddenTitleBarWindowStyle swallowing double-tap Fit-to-Screen events, and Combine ObservableObject 4Hz global re-renders + main-thread disk I/O.

nodes.label: 5-Layer Apple Liquid Glass Optical Architecture
nodes.rationale: Combines dynamic backdrop canvas, native .ultraThinMaterial / NSVisualEffectView vibrancy, dynamic tonal tint overlay, concentric continuous squircles (.continuous), and anisotropic specular rim lighting.

nodes.label: WindowZoomManager & Dual-Trigger Double-Tap Fit-to-Screen
nodes.rationale: Because HiddenTitleBarWindowStyle covers the titlebar with NSHostingView, double-click/double-tap events must be handled via WindowZoomManager toggling window.frame to NSScreen.visibleFrame and restoring savedRestoreFrame.

nodes.label: ZStack + Image.scaledToFill() Layout Inflation Trap
nodes.rationale: Placing a 1:1 square artwork with .scaledToFill() as a direct child in the root ZStack inflates the ZStack height to match the window width (e.g. 1500x1500 in a 1500x850 window), pushing top and bottom bars off-screen; background must be isolated inside a layout-neutral .background modifier.
